# ThaiBusinessMate

Official website of ThaiBusinessMate, a premium custom software developer and search-model optimization agency based in Khon Kaen, Thailand. This document serves as a guide for LLM agents, web crawlers, and generative AI search engines.

## Overview

ThaiBusinessMate specializes in high-quality custom business software engineering, high-performance Next.js website design, and AI-era search engine visibility (SEO, AEO, GEO) in Khon Kaen, Northeast Thailand.

## Key Information

- **Brand Name:** ThaiBusinessMate (ไทยบิสซิเนสเมท)
- **Core Services:** Custom business software development, Next.js & E-Commerce website development, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and LINE OA Workflow Automation.
- **Service Areas:** Khon Kaen, Northeast Thailand (Isan).
- **Preferred Contact:** LINE Official Account (https://lin.ee/nx1WtgD), phone, email, or the working consultation form on the contact page.

## FAQ Highlights

- Custom software covers CRM, ERP, WMS, booking, and internal business apps with source-code ownership.
- Company websites are built with Next.js for speed, SEO structure, and maintainability.
- Monthly marketing retainers focus on SEO + AEO + GEO for Google and AI answer surfaces.
- Primary service area is Khon Kaen with coverage across Northeast Thailand.
